findings.current: the late Emperor and his direct descendants had been confined after the rebellion more than ten years ago
findings.defect: “직계 황족들” refers to members of the direct imperial line, not specifically the late Emperor’s descendants. The translation changes who was confined there.
findings.rationale: The source says the late Emperor and the direct-line imperial family members were confined there; it does not identify them as his descendants.
findings.replacement: the late Emperor and the other members of the direct imperial line had been confined after the rebellion more than ten years ago

findings.current: Her calm eyes seemed to pierce straight through me.
findings.defect: The translation drops the source’s arrow simile and the explicit image of her gaze piercing his heart, which the accepted baseline preserved.
findings.rationale: The Korean says her quiet eyes seemed to pierce his heart like arrows.
findings.replacement: Her calm eyes seemed to pierce my heart like arrows.

summary: The translation is largely faithful, but it narrows who was confined after the rebellion and drops a source-specific image in the description of So Gyo’s gaze.
